segments.en: To the honored self of my beloved dear friend, the delight and desire of my heart — sitting within my heart [בתווני דלבאי יתיב] — the one who is diligently at the doors of repentance [שוקד על דלתי התשובה — Proverbs 8:34 applied as spiritual praise: always seeking the doors of return to G‑d] — who desires to be truly G‑d-fearing — who drinks from the well of living waters of Na Nach Nachma Nachman MayUman [ננמ"ח] — R' Yisrael Dov the Breslover, may he live.
